d:
Sukhe ki mar aur pyase hiran...pani ka zariya sirf ek. magar yahan uski jan ko khatra hai magarmachchh se.
Aisa magarmachchh jisne pahle se hi jal bichhaya hai taki sukhe ke pure mausam ke lie uske lie khane ka intzam ho sake. kya hiran is jal men phans jaega? dekhie ye vidiyo.
Bharat men SONY BBC Earth par Planet Earth III aur aise hi dilchasp sho dekhen.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
